# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We aim to make participating in pi-web a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of
experience level, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, personal appearance,
body size, race, ethnicity, age, religion, or identity.

## Standards that make this project work

Behaviours we expect:

- Be specific and generous with context in reports and reviews. "Does not work" is not actionable;
  commands, versions and observed output are.
- Critique code, not people. Ask questions before asserting someone did something wrong; pi's own
  quirks bite everyone at least once.
- Assume good faith from maintainers and contributors, including non-native English speakers.
- Keep discussions about the software in the repository (issues and discussions), so the reasoning
  stays searchable for the next person.

Unacceptable behaviour: personal attacks, insults, harassment, sexual attention or advances,
publishing private information (such as someone's session paths or data without consent), and other
conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies in all project spaces: issues, discussions, pull requests, commits, and
in any public representation of the project.

## Enforcement

Report issues to **hadi@hadi.tn** (use a subject line that mentions pi-web). Reports are reviewed by
the maintainer and handled confidentially; the reporter's identity is not disclosed, and no credentials,
paths or logs from a report are ever published. Because this is a single-maintainer project,
escalation to a separate committee is not yet possible; if a report concerns the maintainer directly,
say so in the email and a resolution path will be agreed with you.

Enforcement can range from a private note, to removal of non-contributing comments or commits, to a
temporary ban, to a permanent ban from all project spaces. Repeated violations or a single serious
incident can result in an immediate ban.
